newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Meridian Data cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Meridian Data cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Christopher Galvin cut his rating on shares of Meridian Data Inc to hold from buy and his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.20 a share from $0.60.
-- The cuts follow the company's report of fourth quarter earnings of $0.05 a share on sales of $6.0 million versus $0.14 a share on sales of $7.8 million in the year ago quarter.
-- Galvin had forecast earnings of $0.14 a share on revenue of $7.4 million.
-- In a statement, Galvin forecasts two upcoming transitional quarters at Meridian Data due to product line restructuring and price cutting.
